title: slo-platform platform.yaml (apiVersion slo-platform/v1)
description: The instance's platform.yaml, which is also the values of the root chart platform/root (plus `cluster`, set by the root Application). Reference: docs/configuration.md.

product.description: Where the platform comes from. Upgrade = change version.

repo.description: Git URL of the product repository.

version.description: Git ref (tag or branch) of the product the cluster runs.

instance.description: The instance repository: this file, the applications (<apps>/<app>/app.yaml) and their experiments.

repo.description: Git URL of the instance repository.

revision.description: Git ref of the instance repository Argo CD follows.

apps.description: Directory (relative to the instance root, no `..`) holding one directory per application with its app.yaml: <apps>/<app>/app.yaml. `.` = the repository root.

timezone.description: IANA time zone: the regression CronJob's timeZone, quiet hours, the day of synthetic traffic (its standard offset; summer time is ignored there).

language.description: Language of notification texts (notify.language overrides it).

clusters.description: The instance's clusters by name. Each one runs the root chart with its own name as `cluster`.

role.description: prod: notifies, never runs experiments. lab: runs the daily experiment regression, notifies nobody.

runtime.description: Container runtime flavour (Chaos Mesh's containerd socket: k3s keeps its own).

objectStorage.description: in-cluster: SeaweedFS S3 for database backups (needs the Secret object-storage/seaweedfs-s3).

extras.description: Your own components on this cluster: one Argo CD Application extras-<name> per entry, from the instance repository at instance.revision, path <path> (a kustomize directory or plain manifests, typically Applications), into namespace argocd, automated sync with prune and selfHeal.

name.description: The Application is extras-<name>; unique per cluster.

path.description: Directory in the instance repository (relative, no `..`).

applications.description: Which of the instance's applications this cluster runs.

exclude.description: Applications (directory names under instance.apps) this cluster does not run: the ApplicationSet makes no Applications for them here. Their namespaces stay (preserveResourcesOnDeletion) until you delete them.

environments.description: Per application (directory name under instance.apps): which of its environments (app.yaml environments) this cluster leaves out.

exclude.description: Environments of this application the ApplicationSet makes no Applications for on this cluster. Their namespaces stay (preserveResourcesOnDeletion) until you delete them.

environments.description: Which environments (app.yaml environments) this cluster runs, for every application.

exclude.description: Environment names this cluster does not run, of any application: the ApplicationSet makes no Applications for them here. Their namespaces stay (preserveResourcesOnDeletion) until you delete them.

components.description: Per cluster: deep-merged over the top-level components (same keys) for this cluster only.

values.description: Deep-merged into the component's Helm values (maps merge, lists and scalars replace).

pyrra.description: Pyrra (SLO operator and UI): kustomize-sourced, so no `values`.

values.description: Deep-merged into the component's Helm values (maps merge, lists and scalars replace).
Deep-merged into the component's Helm values (maps merge, lists and scalars replace).

cnpg.description: CloudNativePG operator and Barman Cloud plugin: kustomize-sourced, so no `values`.

values.description: Deep-merged into the component's Helm values (maps merge, lists and scalars replace).

experiments.description: the daily experiment regression (lab clusters; chart platform/experiments): Helm-sourced.

kyverno.description: Kyverno (only with optional.policies): kustomize-sourced, so no `values`.

policies.description: the admission policies (only with optional.policies): kustomize-sourced, so no `values`.

object-storage.description: SeaweedFS (only on clusters with objectStorage: in-cluster): kustomize-sourced, so no `values`.

enabled.description: true: Grafana gets a Tempo datasource for `external` (off by default).

queryUrl.description: Tempo's HTTP API (query, TraceQL) as Grafana reaches it, e.g. http://tempo.example:3200: the Tempo datasource's URL.

endpoint.description: Tempo's OTLP/HTTP receiver, e.g. http://tempo.example:4318: what applications set as OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT. Recorded here for people and tools; the platform does not pass it into applications.

external.description: A Tempo outside the cluster (this release has no in-cluster Tempo).

tracing.description: Distributed tracing with an external Grafana Tempo: opt-in (enabled: false by default); needs external.queryUrl. No Application: only platform-monitoring's Grafana changes.

enabled.description: true: Grafana gets a Loki datasource for `external` (off by default).

queryUrl.description: Loki's HTTP API as Grafana reaches it, e.g. http://loki.example:3100: the Loki datasource's URL.

endpoint.description: Loki's push API, e.g. http://loki.example:3100/loki/api/v1/push: what log collectors send to. Recorded here for people and tools; the platform installs no collector.

external.description: A Loki outside the cluster (this release has no in-cluster Loki).

logging.description: Logs in an external Grafana Loki: opt-in (enabled: false by default); needs external.queryUrl. No Application: only platform-monitoring's Grafana changes.

policies.description: Kyverno and the workload admission baseline in every application namespace.

namespaceLabels.description: Labels of every application namespace (app.yaml namespace.labels is merged over them; the slo-platform/* labels always win).

namespaceAnnotations.description: Annotations of every application namespace (app.yaml namespace.annotations is merged over them; chaos-mesh.org/inject always wins).

components.description: Per platform component: enabled (default true) and, for Helm-sourced ones, values merged into its Helm values.

adminSecret.description: Secret in namespace monitoring with keys admin-user and admin-password (bootstrap creates it).

schedule.description: Cron schedule of the daily experiment regression (lab clusters), in `timezone`.

experiments.description: Directories (globs, relative to the instance root) whose *.yaml are the experiments of the daily regression and of `slo-platform check`. Default: <instance.apps>/*/experiments.

dayMinutes.description: Length of one synthetic-traffic day in minutes (1440: a real day; less compresses it, for quick tests).

notify.description: Who hears what on prod clusters (lab clusters notify nobody). Secrets come from the secrets file's notify: (docs/configuration.md#notify).

deadman.description: Dead man's switch: Alertmanager's always-firing Watchdog POSTed to an outside watcher (e.g. healthchecks.io) every interval; it alarms when the pings stop.

url.description: The ping URL when it holds no secret; else leave it out (secret deadmanUrl).

secretKey.description: Secret key of the ping URL (default deadmanUrl).

interval.description: How often Watchdog is sent (group_interval and repeat_interval of its route).

language.description: Overrides the top-level language for notification texts.

cluster.description: Root chart only (the root Application's Helm parameter): which entry of clusters this rendering is for.

receiver-slack.description: Slack incoming webhook. Secret: slackWebhookUrl (the webhook URL).

secretKey.description: Secret key of the webhook URL (default slackWebhookUrl).

threadId.description: Topic (message thread) in a forum group.

secretKey.description: Secret key of the bot token (default telegramBotToken).
Secret key of the webhook URL (default discordWebhookUrl).

receiver-email.description: E-mail over SMTP. Secret: smtpPassword when username is set.

username.description: SMTP login; the password comes from the secret.

secretKey.description: Secret key of the SMTP password (default smtpPassword).

receiver-webhook.description: Alertmanager's JSON (version 4) POSTed to a URL. Secret: webhookUrl unless url is given.

url.description: The endpoint when it holds no secret; else leave it out and set the secret.

secretKey.description: Secret key of the URL (default webhookUrl).
Secret key of the application token (default pushoverToken).

userSecretKey.description: Secret key of the user / group key (default pushoverUserKey).

receiver-ntfy.description: ntfy (ntfy.sh or your own server) through Alertmanager's webhook with ntfy's JSON publishing. Secret: only for protected topics (secretKey: an access token).

topic.description: The topic. On a public server anyone who knows it can read it: use a long random name or a protected topic.

secretKey.description: Secret key of an access token (Bearer), for protected topics; none by default.

receiver-msteams.description: Microsoft Teams (Workflows webhook, msteamsv2). Secret: msteamsWebhookUrl.

secretKey.description: Secret key of the webhook URL (default msteamsWebhookUrl).
Secret key of the webhook URL (default mattermostWebhookUrl).

receivers.description: Receivers, each notified of every alert of this severity (prod clusters only).
